provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Great Wall rulebook (EN), section 12 Setup

steps.text: Main board in the middle, side up for your player count
Shame token pool: {n}; supplies of Wood, Stone, Gold, Chi, Wound, Shame and Honor tokens; Wall levels nearby
Time token, empty side up, in the Time track slot for your player count
3 random Artifact cards faceup in the Artifact slots; box the rest
Shuffle the Horde deck on the top side of the board; 1 Horde in each first-row slot
4 players: 1 more Horde card by the Invasion indicator on the next card's back
9 Barricades, one on each Barricade slot
Shuffle the Tactic deck facedown in its slot
Advisor deck by the Advisor track; 4 faceup in its slots
Each player: a Clan's 6 Command cards, 8 Clerks, 16 Soldiers (10 Spearmen, 4 Archers, 2 Horsemen), screen, Honor and Tea markers
Deal 2 Generals and 2 Advisors each; keep 1 General; 1 Advisor active faceup, the other facedown under the General
3 Clerks in the Clerk space of the board
Take the Resources and Tactic cards shown at the bottom of your General
Honor marker on 0; Tea markers stacked by the General's Tea value, highest on top
The first Year begins with Fall (skip Spring and Summer)
